hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean UI chrome with intentional per-subtree color assignment and depth opacity, but the 900px SVG overflows the viewport causing the visualization to render cropped, and the dense edge bundles converging at center create visual noise without enough contrast to read individual connections.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout radius encoding, data-driven domains via d3.extent throughout, and key functions on main joins; minor gap is hierarchy-link join lacks a key function, and the sunburst y-scale domain is hardcoded to a visual constant rather than data-derived.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: tension-slider fires un-throttled redrawLinks() on every input event; switching to force layout starts a 750ms flubber shape-morph transition then immediately runs the force simulation tick loop updating the same node transforms with no .interrupt() call; and the t.tween('render') callback closes over module-level nodeSelection/linkSelection which are replaced wholesale by regenerateAndRender(), so a mid-flight tween can operate on the wrong selection after a dataset regeneration.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view approach and click-to-fade interaction manage the 300-edge density well in theory, but the default 8% tension renders bundles as near-straight lines that pile into a dense tangle at cluster boundaries, obscuring structure before any interaction occurs; the 8-button layout switcher plus four secondary controls add meaningful UI chrome overhead.
